description: Returns one episode's full timed transcript as Markdown, with speaker names and HH:MM:SS timestamps, preceded by its title, page URL and the primary sources it cites. Use this when you need exact wording, or to quote or locate a passage; get_episode is shorter when a summary is enough. The speakers, Maya and Alex, are AI-generated voices.

id.description: Episode id as returned by search_episodes or list_episodes, for example 2026-11-20-nginx-five-teams-daily.

name: get_transcript
title: Get one episode's timed transcript
